# Kogan & DiSalvo, P.A.

> Florida-based personal injury law firm specializing in car accidents, mass torts, and catastrophic injury claims with free consultations across South Florida.

Kogan & DiSalvo, P.A. is a personal injury law firm serving Florida clients across multiple locations including Boca Raton, Fort Lauderdale, and surrounding areas. The firm handles a wide range of cases from auto accidents to complex mass tort litigation involving defective medical devices and pharmaceutical products.
